title: psyllium euphraticum
intro: Psyllium euphraticum, commonly known as Indian plantago, is a type of herbaceous plant that belongs to the plantago family. The health benefits of Psyllium euphraticum include its ability to support digestive health, lower cholesterol levels, and regulate blood sugar levels due to its high fiber content. Therapeutically, Psyllium euphraticum is known to act as a bulk-forming laxative, soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Psyllium euphraticum include mucilage, a complex mixture of polysaccharides, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
